pageDesc: A negamax + alpha-beta tic-tac-toe AI playing itself on a Super Nintendo — the negate-on-return recursion (G_SUB 0,x) with a running G_SMAX and alpha-beta cutoffs. Compiler stress-test #92.
heading: PlyOracle
lede: A negamax + alpha-beta tic-tac-toe AI playing itself. Negamax folds minimax into one routine by negating the returned score at each ply (score = -negamax(child), a G_SUB 0,x), with a running G_SMAX for the best move and an alpha-beta cutoff that prunes the search. That alternating-sign recursion is a shape the battery other recursive demos never produce. Compiler stress-test #92.
